title: ruscus hypophyllum var. hypoglossum
intro: Ruscus hypophyllum var. hypoglossum, commonly known as Polynesian Lady's Finger, is a type of flowering plant in the family Asparagaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and lowering blood pressure. The health benefits of Ruscus hypophyllum var. hypoglossum include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and vasodilator, providing therapeutic actions such as reducing muscle spasms and improving circulation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
